description: This file defines the ShoppingCartFacade interface which provides an abstraction layer for shopping cart operations such as adding, removing, updating, and retrieving shopping cart data. It acts as a bridge between core business models and web controllers, exposing only data objects.

classes.name: ShoppingCartFacade
classes.description: Interface providing methods for managing shopping cart data, including creation, update, deletion, and retrieval operations.

methods.name: addItemsToShoppingCart
methods.description: Adds an item to the shopping cart and returns the updated data.

methods.name: createCartModel
methods.description: Creates a new shopping cart model based on cart code, store, and customer.

methods.name: getShoppingCartData
methods.description: Retrieves shopping cart data based on customer, store, and cart ID, or from an existing ShoppingCart object.

methods.name: removeCartItem
methods.description: Removes an item by ID from the specified shopping cart.

methods.name: updateCartItem
methods.description: Updates the quantity of an item in the shopping cart.

methods.name: deleteShoppingCart
methods.description: Deletes a shopping cart identified by ID or code for the given store.

methods.name: updateCartItems
methods.description: Updates multiple items in the shopping cart.

methods.name: getShoppingCartModel
methods.description: Retrieves the shopping cart model by cart code or customer.
